repos.author: chopratejas
repos.name: headroom
repos.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 60-95% fewer tokens, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
repos.summary: A token compression tool for LLMs. Reduces prompt/context size by 60-95% by compressing logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the model. Offers library, proxy, and MCP server modes — useful for cutting API costs on long-context tasks.

repos.author: affaan-m
repos.name: ECC
repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary: A performance optimization harness for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.). Adds structured skills, instincts, memory management, and security layers to make agentic coding more reliable and efficient.

repos.author: aquasecurity
repos.name: trivy
repos.description: Find vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, secrets, SBOM in containers, Kubernetes, code repositories, clouds and more
repos.summary: Comprehensive security scanner from Aqua Security. Detects vulnerabilities, misconfigs, secrets, and generates SBOMs across containers, Kubernetes, cloud environments, and code repos. A DevSecOps staple.

repos.author: NousResearch
repos.name: hermes-agent
repos.description: The agent that grows with you
repos.summary: An adaptive AI agent from Nous Research that reportedly improves/grows through use. The tagline suggests it learns from context and feedback — likely an agent framework with memory and self-improvement mechanisms.

repos.author: microsoft
repos.name: markitdown
repos.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
repos.summary: Microsoft's document-to-Markdown converter. Handles common office formats (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF) and outputs clean Markdown — great for prepping content for LLM ingestion or static site generation.

repos.author: nesquena
repos.name: hermes-webui
repos.description: Hermes WebUI: The best way to use Hermes Agent from the web or from your phone!
repos.summary: A web-based UI for the Hermes Agent, enabling access from browser or mobile. Pairs with hermes-agent to provide a friendly frontend for an otherwise CLI-driven agentic AI system.

repos.author: D4Vinci
repos.name: Scrapling
repos.description: 🕷️ An adaptive Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl!
repos.summary: An adaptive web scraping framework that scales from one-off requests to full crawls. The 'adaptive' claim suggests it handles dynamic content, anti-scraping measures, and varying site structures automatically.

repos.author: opendataloader-project
repos.name: opendataloader-pdf
repos.description: PDF Parser for AI-ready data. Automate PDF accessibility. Open-source.
repos.summary: A PDF parser purpose-built for AI workloads. Focuses on extracting structured, machine-readable data from PDFs and automating accessibility — designed to feed LLM pipelines with clean document content.

repos.author: odoo
repos.name: odoo
repos.description: Odoo. Open Source Apps To Grow Your Business.
repos.summary: Odoo's main ERP/business app platform. An open-source suite covering CRM, accounting, inventory, e-commerce, and more — a full-featured alternative to paid SaaS tools for business operations.

repos.author: Open-LLM-VTuber
repos.name: Open-LLM-VTuber
repos.description: Talk to any LLM with hands-free voice interaction, voice interruption, and Live2D taking face running locally across platforms
repos.summary: A voice-first LLM interface with a Live2D animated avatar. Supports hands-free interaction, voice interruption, and runs locally across platforms — blends VTuber tech with any OpenAI-compatible LLM.
